verdicts.reason: Both put the crowd illustration in a hard-cropped inset box with figures sliced at the top and sides. The original lets the crowd bleed off the canvas, so this loses its feel. Both also keep the forced break that leaves 'INDEED,' alone on its own line, and the very loose line spacing makes the quote look like a list. A has more even margins and more breathing room. B uses larger type with tighter margins: the attribution line runs to about 29px from the right edge, unlike the wider left margin, and the quote and attribution are cramped against the image above.
